scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules dist client/node_modules client/dist server/node_modules server/dist
scripts.build: bun run api && bun run typecheck && bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.test: bun run test:client && bun run test:server
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:client && bun run typecheck:server
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bkper app sync && bkper app deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run build && bkper app sync && bkper app deploy --preview
